title: Campus facilities
content: Campus life includes smart classrooms, a library and research spaces, innovation laboratories, performing arts, sports facilities, clubs and leadership activities.

title: Sports and wellbeing
content: Sport is part of a whole-child experience, with coaching, character-building and opportunities to participate across campus sporting facilities.

title: Transport
content: GPS-enabled transport routes are available across Pune, with trained staff and clear communication for families. The admissions team can confirm route availability for a specific area.
